  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.chevalley x y h →
          Reduction.basisFacts l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 →
            Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
              Reduction.commonFacts p l (act y) v0 M → Reduction.scalarFacts p K M → ∀ r ≤ l.toNat, ↑r.factorial ≠ 0
